title: How to Draw Hair: Art Tutorial
editorial_title: Drawing hair with whole-body strokes, rhythm, references, and revision
summary: A 6:52 tutorial that uses Emeril Lagasse’s Bam persona to transform a stick figure through whole-arm/body hair strokes. It moves through shading/highlights, bun/Princess Leia, starburst, ponytail, Mohawk/Kid ’n Play, strays, Medusa and Jennifer Aniston/Friends feathering while invoking The Cure, sword/nunchuck movement, leg-day/off-balance/no-rhythm self-critique, gendered shave-head/grow-long-hair advice, Vidal Sassoon/product/paycheck jokes, and drawing-level haircut/scissors/hat recovery. Four damaged phrases remain unresolved. Every idea remains without becoming ergonomic, exercise, weapon, gender, hair-care or scissor guidance.

speaker_policy.status: single tutorial performance with performed objections; identity withheld
speaker_policy.reason: Publisher/self-address context suggests David Choe, but captions lack prefixes and held-out acoustic validation.
